boundaries: Construction Profile defines stages; it is not the invariant itself.
Construction Binding binds an exact subject to a construction graph; it is not an implementation binding.
Implementation Binding maps a system model to implementation targets; it does not prove implementation conformance.
Evaluation Profile defines checks; Evaluation records results.
claim_ceiling: Candidate Definition reconstructed from the selected D65 planning successor. It does not alter CyberAlchemy-v2, enter the admitted Lab Definition registry, activate construction policy, or authorize implementation or migration.

scope.applicability: Construction of a new or materially revised implementation-bearing system or capability in CyberAlchemy-lab.
exclusions: Purely narrative edits with no implementation-bearing system change.
Admission, activation, publication, release, deployment, or external-effect decisions.

examples: The 176 migration scaffolds remain prototypes until family schemas and tests exist.
The D65 vertical tests one Definition, Artifact Types, and profiles before wider reconstruction.
domain_context.explanation: The CyberAlchemy-v2 reconstruction uses this invariant to turn reviewed source meanings into candidate Lab artifacts without copying source structure or treating tests as admission.

plain_language.explanation: First learn with explicit prototypes. Freeze and test one exact product only when the model is coherent. Product approval may then be considered, while every real-world authority decision remains separate.

boundary_conditions: Prototype epochs may iterate without admission requests.
Testing binds one exact frozen candidate.
Changed acceptance-bound bytes require a new test and approval epoch.
Authority decisions occur only after product approval and remain separate.
scientific_formal.formal_expression: D -> O_s -> P* -> freeze(P_c@h) -> test(P_c@h) -> eligible(product_approval) -> decision(product_approval) -> eligible(separate_authority_request); O_s.authority=none; product_approval =/=> operational_authority
scientific_formal.normative_statement: An implementation-bearing construction must begin with prototype definitions, use ontology only as non-authoritative navigation scaffolding, iterate product and implementation prototypes, freeze one exact product candidate, obtain current product-test evidence, and become eligible for product approval before any separate authority request. Product approval grants no operational authority.

notation.meaning: Iterative product, business, DomainSpec, compiled-system, and implementation prototypes.
One frozen product candidate bound to exact digest h.

testable_conditions: Every construction stage has an explicit typed carrier.
Product-test evidence binds the frozen candidate digest.
No authority request precedes exact product approval evidence.
